title: diplazium iridiphyllum
intro: Diplazium iridiphyllum, commonly known as the Himalayan Lady fern, is a species of fern native to the Himalayas and other parts of Asia. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Diplazium iridiphyllum are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include flavonoids, glycosides, and phenolic acids, among others.
